acceptedReason.description: Optional owner-supplied acceptance reason. An absent or empty value remains blocking for gate evaluation.

baselineValue.description: Baseline value in the unit named by metric semantics, or null when no comparable baseline value exists.

codeArea.description: Vibe Check code-area identifier associated with the warning.

comparisonBasis.description: Producer-owned explanation of the threshold or comparison basis used for this warning.

deltaValue.description: Current-minus-baseline delta in the warning metric unit, or null when no comparable delta exists.

isChanged.description: Whether the warning is associated with the invocation's changed-file scope.

level.description: Closed warning severity used by machine consumers.

line.description: One-based source line within path, or null when the warning applies without a single line.

metric.description: Stable normalized metric identifier evaluated by the warning rule.

path.description: Product-normalized project-relative path using forward slashes; never an absolute host path.

sourceTool.description: Normalized name of the measurement source that supports the warning.

value.description: Current observed value in the unit named by metric semantics.

description: One normalized quality warning. Object member order has no instance meaning.
title: Vibe Check machine warning v1
